author: kue2z
quote: After 60 hours of playing GTA 6, I’m deeply disappointed. Especially with the story and the worldview the game expresses. It has already lost what was at the core of GTA: satirizing the absurdity of reality and dark humor. It has become a life simulator, with the protagonists’ personalities deliberately toned down. Obedience and domestication are the core message of this game. In short, extremely disappointing.
